title: Constraint cost on an assignment
statement: Let a constraint template specify Boolean-valued predicates, let $c$ be one of its constraints, and let $\sigma$ assign a domain value to every variable. The cost of the valued term associated to $c$, evaluated at $\sigma$, equals $0$ if $c$ is satisfied and $1$ if it is not.
